app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $95 non-refundable application fee; the domestic fee is $75.
app_fee.quote: Application fee is $75 for domestic students and $95 for international students.

fee_waiver.value: The application fee is waived only for current Mines students, alumni and staff, plus GEM and McNair applicants; the Admissions Office does not waive other fees.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is waived for current Mines students, alumni and staff

also.quote: Unfortunately, The Admissions Office does not waive applications fees.

gre_general.value: The GRE is required only for some programs, so each program record sets its own rule.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is required for some programs.

toefl_min.value: The university's TOEFL minimum sits in a table that does not read as quotable text; department rules are on the program records.

ielts_min.value: The university's IELTS minimum sits in a table that does not read as quotable text; department rules are on the program records.

english_waiver.value: The test is waived only for a degree completed within the last two years in a university-approved country; the country chart does not read as text, so confirm with grad-admissions@mines.edu.
english_waiver.quote: Completion of a university degree program (or a minimum 18 credit hours) in a university-approved country (see chart below) within the last two years from submitting a completed application requirement.

also.quote: Applicants who are not US citizens or permanent residents must submit English Proficiency scores as part of the application process
